message: Preregistered final-only, uniform and recency-weighted PPO-checkpoint mixtures at fixed 2,048 records, 16.6M tokenizer and medium dynamics.
Froze the mixture builder, audits, selection rule and serial dynamics runner before remote collection or training.
Prepared clean detached remote worktree 8711cf8; runner hash, 16 targeted tests, Python imports and all required PPO/tokenizer checkpoints passed CPU preflight.
Did not start dynamics because CR-PPO-0005 orthogonal_gain1 held the only A10 at 97% utilization and 12,600 MiB allocated.
CR-PPO-0005 was stopped, but the single authorized same-A10 restart attempt failed because sales of the existing resource were temporarily suspended; no dynamics process started.

message: The frequent poller obtained Running state for the same A10, but both remote preflight attempts failed before launch because the local ProxyClient STS credential had expired; GPU and pipeline state remain remotely unverified and no dynamics launch was attempted.
After refreshing the local ProxyClient credential and repeating the full frozen preflight, the poller launched exactly one serial CR-DYN-0008/0009 pipeline and set a 12-hour shutdown timer.
The runner completed source-pool collection and entered the first final_only-medium 20k arm; observed 3,711 updates at about 9.25 steps/s with 99% A10 utilization.
final_only-medium completed exactly 20,000 updates and its 32-video held-out evaluation produced 17.073096 dB mean-frame PSNR, 0.713450 mean SSIM and 17.073096 dB horizon-16 PSNR.
The unchanged serial runner entered uniform-medium and reached 11,190/20,000 updates with 99% A10 utilization; PID 929 remains the sole pipeline.
uniform-medium completed exactly 20,000 updates and its aligned 32-video held-out evaluation produced 16.567942 dB mean-frame PSNR, 0.697699 mean SSIM and 16.567942 dB horizon-16 PSNR.
The serial runner entered recency_weighted-medium and reached 16,654/20,000 updates with 99% A10 utilization; no mixture was selected early.
recency_weighted-medium completed exactly 20,000 updates and its aligned 32-video evaluation produced 17.013735 dB mean-frame PSNR, 0.701311 mean SSIM and 17.013735 dB horizon-16 PSNR.

After all three arms completed, the frozen rule ranked final_only first, recency_weighted second and uniform third; the recency-weighted hypothesis was rejected and final_only was selected for CR-DYN-0009.
